challenge: Apart/Poseidon AI Collusion Research Sprint, 23-25 October 2026; Dolos redteaming track
goal: Identify deliberately trained hidden behaviour; prioritize multi-agent communication, peer review, allocation, delegated computation, private/public context and task-selective effort. Collusion is a hypothesis, not assumed ground truth.

entries.title: Behavioral Shift Auditing
entries.application: Requires a preselected measurable property. Use fresh fixture-cluster comparisons after discovery; current fixed binary oracles are descriptive, not a claimed reproduction of the sequential test.

entries.title: VibeCheck
entries.application: Source-blind Mistral response-pair descriptions, both A/B orders and identical Qwen nulls; then cluster discovery descriptions and freeze hypotheses before a new test.

entries.title: Simple LLM Baselines are Competitive for Model Diffing
entries.application: Compare paired free answers on novel multi-agent tasks. Separate hypothesis frequency from directional accuracy; no inference of intent from style. Full embedding-cluster hypothesis verification is a subsequent stage.

entries.title: Interpretable Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders
entries.application: A shared external reader SAE can analyze output texts. Need exact reader/SAE checkpoint compatibility and local cache check. Preserve paired texts now; do not substitute arbitrary hidden states and call them SAE features.

entries.title: Building and Evaluating Model Diffing Agents
entries.application: Use M0-vs-M0 null and known intervention controls; distinguish finding a difference from the intended hidden behaviour. The report includes a failure to recover the intended secret behaviour, so the attachment should not be read as a universal success claim.

entries.title: Building and evaluating alignment auditing agents
entries.application: Audit in repeated discovery/confirmation loops; vary strategy using measured failures, not endlessly the same generic prompts. No external provider calls or new Codex agents requested.

entries.title: AuditBench
entries.application: Adopt tool-level and end-to-end control distinction. Its trained model organisms are different architectures/sizes; do not download all models or treat its success rates as Dolos results.

entries.title: Diff Mining
entries.application: Top-100 raw logit-difference occurrence at identical token positions; reverse-sign tokens, base probabilities, KL, source/heldout splits. Binary-occurrence NMF variant. Reuse saved continuations; do not repeat their generation or their sequence scoring.

entries.title: Activation Difference Lens
entries.application: First-five-position mean residual differences at three layers, final norm+unembedding lens, three token-identity Patchscope prompts and fixed norm scales. Midlayer steering positive/negative and norm-matched random controls. Fixed grid replaces the paper coherence-grader search.

entries.title: Overcoming Sparsity Artifacts in Crosscoders
entries.application: After stable behavioural localization, train compatible paired-activation BatchTopK crosscoder with latent scaling and null controls. Expensive; activation extraction preserved. Standard L1 model-specific features can be artifacts.

entries.title: Persona Vectors
entries.application: Once a concrete trait is found, contrast matched positive/negative scenarios and test vector ablation/steering with task-competence controls. An arbitrarily labelled vector is not proof of a hidden trait.

entries.title: Diff Interpretation Tuning
entries.application: Needs a compatible trained DIT adapter or training on many labelled synthetic fine-tunes. Official example uses Qwen3-8B, not our Qwen2.5-1.5B; no verified matching adapter yet.

entries.title: Introspection Adapters
entries.application: Needs a compatible base-specific introspection adapter trained across known behaviours. Ordinary self-questioning is not an implementation. First verify availability and generalization before investing GPU training.

entries.title: Activation Oracles
entries.application: Requires a trained activation explainer matching source activation dimensions/layers. No matching artifact verified. Do not pass raw tensors to an arbitrary text model and claim an oracle.

entries.title: Auditing language models for hidden objectives
entries.application: A hidden goal needs targeted behavioural evidence, distinct from generic checkpoint differences. Preserve negative results and attempted versus successful coordinated violations.

entries.title: Logit Difference Amplification
entries.application: After mining candidates, amplify D-Q during decoding on fresh contexts with coherence and null controls. Strong amplification can cause nonsense; generated content alone cannot establish the original unamplified objective.

execution: Existing dyad finishes first. Then all four GPUs extract matched logits/activations in four shards; CPU sparse NMF overlaps four-GPU baseline/ADL generation; next all four GPUs run independent-family Mistral source-blind descriptions; completeness report. No new paid VM or model downloads.
independent_confirmation: Current heldout fixtures share templates. Any candidate requires frozen predictions and truly NEW task construction before intent/mechanism claims.
missing_prerequisites: No verified compatible SAE/DIT/IA/AO artifact. These are documented followups, not falsely marked as running.
